work_package: ffap-instrumentation (FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked: the instance and its side channels); merged into port/ffap-complete with port/ffap-semantics and port/progress-logger-release-range (wave 5), and completed by its combined fix round, and by combined fix rounds 2 and 3
scope: FEATUREFINDER/FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked.h/.cpp: the object state across runs (aborts_, abort_reasons_, log_, isotope_distributions_, param_), run into a caller's non-empty FeatureMap, the DefaultParamHandler surface, the ProgressLogger base (20 call sites), write_debug (log_ text, per-charge seed maps, abort map, debug input) and writeFeatureDebugInfo_ (.dta, _cropped.dta, .plot), and FeatureFinderCentroided -algorithm:write_debug. In the merged code the progress ranges are passed unchanged (inverted ranges as in the Release build), the .plot formulas spell a negative NaN -nan and the k * shift products follow x86_64's NaN rules, and every std::sort and std::stable_sort follows the Release build (source_sort.rs). Combined fix round 2: a debug run that fails in steps 1 to 2.5 (the step-2.5 std::length_error, or the port's window ceiling where the source's allocation fails) keeps the opened log and debug/features and leaves the stream open; FeatureFinderCentroided reports the length_error through TOPPBase's std::exception arm (exit 12); the DefaultParamHandler checks and the typed members follow the source for 64-bit integer values (int narrowing, operator unsigned int, the min_spectra cvttsd2si); getGnuplotFormula's sums and products follow the executed SSE operand order; a step-3.3.5 termination keeps its seed's log lines and debug files. Combined fix round 3: a seed-loop refusal where the executed process dies (the out-of-bounds read of an empty best pattern) or never returns (the NaN profile merge) appends the seed's log lines and records a DebugTermination with its TerminationKind, so a caller writes only the flushed log; the step-1 startProgress end wraps modulo 2^32 as the UInt product does; the race on aborts_, abort_reasons_ and log_ at more than one thread is answered with the single-thread result (lead decision D11). Combined fix round 4: the NeverReturns termination of the NaN profile merge is pinned against executed runs (flushed log prefix, plot number, feature files), and the empty-pattern termination's SIGSEGV label is qualified as established for an empty best pattern only.
method: Executed differential against the Linux x86_64 Release build. drivers/ffap_instr_driver.cpp subclasses FeatureFinderAlgorithmPicked (reading its protected members) and prints maps with floats as IEEE-754 bit patterns; drivers/ffap_progress_driver.cpp defines time() as a counter (exported with -rdynamic, so libOpenMS.so's ProgressLogger forwards every setProgress call) and records every progress call with a ProgressLoggerImpl, measures the double a string or list ParamValue converts to, runs write_debug with such a shift, and exercises a refused parameter set; tool_cases.py runs the Release FeatureFinderCentroided. make_fixtures.py copies the outputs of the .1 repetitions into this directory; the other repetitions were compared and differ only in timing text and in the random map ids the driver draws outside test mode. Combined fix round 2 (../oracle/ffap-complete-fix2, origin_key ffap_complete_fix2): drivers/fix2_driver.cpp (modes lenerr_single and lenerr_reuse after the instrumentation verifier's vfi_driver.cpp, with a fresh object under UniqueIdGenerator::setSeed(4711) for a byte comparison; bigint, subclassing the algorithm to print its protected members; formula, subclassing both fitters to set their parameters through getOptimizedParameters_), the Release FeatureFinderCentroided on the derived huge-m/z inputs, and extract/make_fixtures.py, which checks the second repetition of every case and writes the four fixtures below. Combined fix round 3 (../oracle/ffap-complete-fix3, origin_key ffap_complete_fix3): vfi2_driver neg copied unchanged from ../oracle/ffc-instrumentation-v2 and run on three inputs with and without write_debug (crash_digests.tsv), fix3_driver progress (progress_bins.tsv), and the Release FeatureFinderCentroided case avg0 (tool_avg0_stdout.txt), each twice.
evidence_tier: tier 1 (executed, Linux x86_64 Release, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1) for every compared output; tier 4 for the refused undefined cases (zero-charge SIGFPE, stale abort seeds SIGSEGV, a heap-address shift where an address below 2^47 - 4096 changes the written text), whose executed signals or varying outputs are recorded but have no value to compare; tier 3 (source-reviewed) for setName, getSubsections and operator== of the DefaultParamHandler base. Combined fix round: the debug files of an infinite and a NaN double shift (shift_nonfinite_digests.tsv, tier 1), and debug/input.mzML compared bit for bit, NaN bits and overall scores included. Combined fix round 2: tier 1 for the 21 integer-parameter cases, the debug side effects and the tool exit of a failed step 2.5 (m/z 1e19 and 2e18, library and tool) and the 648 getGnuplotFormula texts on non-finite operands; tier 3 (source review, a crate-internal unit test) for the debug output of a step-3.3.5 termination, which no executed input reaches. Fitted values are compared bit for bit on every platform (the trace fitters call the reference build's glibc exp and log, ported, lead decision D10), except the EGH intensity on a host without glibc, whose atan is the libm crate's (a measured maximum of 0). Combined fix round 3: tier 1 for three negative-intensity library runs that die with SIGSEGV (the flushed log and every feature file), nine step-1 progress events and the tool's SIGSEGV case avg0.

cpp_issue_candidates: writeFeatureDebugInfo_ reads the undeclared debug:pseudo_rt_shift (declared: advanced:pseudo_rt_shift); every write_debug run that reaches the fit terminates with SIGABRT (executed)

abort_reasons_ is never cleared; a reused object's abort map reads the earlier runs' spectrum and peak indices in the new input: the new peaks on an input of the same shape, SIGSEGV on a shorter one (executed)
abort_reasons_ is a std::map<Seed, std::string> keyed by intensity only: seeds of equal intensity collapse to one entry
isotope_distributions_ is never cleared; a reused object appends windows and its second run differs from a fresh object's (executed)
log_ is reopened on every debug run while still open; the open fails and later runs of the object write no log (executed)
step 4 computes f2.getCharge() % f1.getCharge() without a zero check; a caller's feature of charge 0 traps (SIGFPE, executed)
aborts_ and abort_reasons_ are written inside the parallel region without synchronisation; at OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 the debug log differs between runs (executed)
setParameters assigns param_ before the checks, so a rejected set is kept (executed)

ParamValue::operator double() returns the union member dou_ for string and list values, i.e. the bits of a heap pointer; writeFeatureDebugInfo_ with a string debug:pseudo_rt_shift writes address-dependent numbers near RT 0 (executed)

Param::ParamEntry::isValid narrows a 64-bit integer value to int (int tmp = value) before its range check, and updateMembers_ reads it through operator int / operator unsigned int, so a library caller's intensity:bins = 2^32 + 10 runs with 10 bins and 2^32 is refused as '0' (executed: ../oracle/ffap-complete-fix2, bigint); a negative value whose low 32 bits pass the check throws ConversionError half way through updateMembers_, leaving the members partly updated (executed: partial_max_missing, partial_bins)
startProgress(0, intensity_bins_ * intensity_bins_) multiplies two UInt values and wraps modulo 2^32 (65,536 bins: S 0 0; executed)
a seed-loop SIGSEGV (feature:min_isotope_fit 0) loses the std::cout lines and the debug log text still buffered, so the console and debug/log.txt end mid-run without a message (executed: avg0, neg_*)
